title: Inhibition of oxidative stress and the Neuropilin-2-induced neuroinflammatory pathway by EMO ameliorates epileptic seizures in the preclinical model of epilepsy.
authors: Li, Haiting; Zhang, Yujia; Zhang, Yangyang; Li, Yuehui; Wang, Huifang
journal: Redox report : communications in free radical research
one_liner_zh: 该研究评估大黄素在癫痫模型中的神经保护作用，涉及NF-kappaB等蛋白的分子对接，但核心是疾病表型与氧化应激通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，方法仅为简单对接，与课题关联微弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Epilepsy is a chronic neurological condition characterized by recurrent seizures, often linked to neuroinflammation and oxidative stress that exacerbate neuronal injury. Neuropilin-2 (NRP2) and Nuclear Factor-Kappa B (NF-kappaB) are key mediators in these pathways. This study evaluated the neuroprotective effects of emodin, a bioactive anthraquinone with antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, in a pentylenetetrazole (PTZ)-induced mouse model of epilepsy. METHODS: Seizure severity, anxiety-like behavior (Elevated Plus Maze), and cognitive function (Morris Water Maze) were assessed. Oxidative stress markers including glutathione (GSH), catalase, lipid peroxidation (LPO), and glutathione-S-transferase (GST) were measured. Expression of NRP2, NF-kappaB, and proinflammatory cytokines (TNF-alpha, IL-6) was quantified. Docking studies examined emodin's binding affinity to NRP2 and NF-kappaB. RESULTS: Emodin (200 mg/kg) significantly reduced seizure frequency and severity, improved anxiety-like behavior, and enhanced cognition. Biochemical analysis showed restored oxidative balance, with increased GSH and catalase activity and reduced LPO and GST dysfunction. Molecular studies revealed downregulation of NRP2, NF-kappaB, and cytokines. Docking confirmed strong binding affinity to NRP2 and NF-kappaB. CONCLUSION: Emodin alleviates oxidative stress and neuroinflammation by modulating NRP2 and NF-kappaB pathways, suggesting therapeutic potential in epilepsy.
abstract_zh: 目的：癫痫是一种以反复发作为特征的慢性神经系统疾病，常与神经炎症和氧化应激相关，这些因素加剧神经元损伤。神经纤毛蛋白-2（NRP2）和核因子-κB（NF-kappaB）是这些通路中的关键介质。本研究评估了大黄素（一种具有抗氧化和抗炎特性的生物活性蒽醌）在戊四唑（PTZ）诱导的小鼠癫痫模型中的神经保护作用。方法：评估了癫痫发作严重程度、焦虑样行为（高架十字迷宫）和认知功能（Morris水迷宫）。测量了氧化应激标志物，包括谷胱甘肽（GSH）、过氧化氢酶、脂质过氧化（LPO）和谷胱甘肽-S-转移酶（GST）。量化了NRP2、NF-kappaB和促炎细胞因子（TNF-alpha、IL-6）的表达。对接研究检查了大黄素与NRP2和NF-kappaB的结合亲和力。结果：大黄素（200 mg/kg）显著降低了癫痫发作频率和严重程度，改善了焦虑样行为，并增强了认知能力。生化分析显示氧化平衡恢复，GSH和过氧化氢酶活性增加，LPO和GST功能障碍减少。分子研究显示NRP2、NF-kappaB和细胞因子表达下调。对接证实了与NRP2和NF-kappaB的强结合亲和力。结论：大黄素通过调节NRP2和NF-kappaB通路减轻氧化应激和神经炎症，提示其在癫痫中的治疗潜力。
